Ash Chen: Hey everyone  first day here! Im Ash (ML infra), remote SF. Quick questions: 1) My MDM invite shows 'pending' after I clicked accept. 2) Where do I request a VPN token for personal hotspot testing? 3) Who handles desk plant requests? Fun fact: I knit tiny hats for my dog, Miso :dog:
Onboarding-Bot: Welcome Ash! :tada: If MDM stays pending for >30m run `mdm-status --refresh` and attach the output to an IT ticket. VPN test tokens are requested via the security portal under "Temporary Tokens". Desk plants are coordinated by People Ops (form link in the welcome checklist).
Marta Gomez: welcome Ash!! Im on ML infra too  welcome buddy. For MDM we sometimes need to re-send the invite if an alias was used. Ill DM IT right now. Also ping @noel for the VPN token flow, he keeps a small stash for testing.
Noel Chen: hey Ash  welcome aboard. Ill pull a temp VPN token for you, no prob. DM me your primary email. Also we have a plant shelf in the SF office if you ever want to swap cuttings.
People-Ops: Hi Ash  welcome! We emailed the plant stipend link and desk setup preferences. For remote plant shipments in SF we can arrange delivery via our partner. Also FYI we do a Friday coffee chat at 10am PST  join if you can!
Ash Chen: thanks all  I ran the refresh and pasted the output into the IT ticket. DMing Noel now. Will definitely join the coffee chat on Friday  and Miso says hi (shes currently modeling a tiny hat) :blush:
